entries.title: Crewmates carry on as soon as you allow a secret run
entries.body: When you allow a crewmate's run that uses your secrets, the crewmate now hears right away that the program started and carries on, instead of waiting until the program ends. If Infinitary closes while such a run waits or runs, its crewmate hears how the run ended as soon as Infinitary opens again.
entries.noPicture: Nothing on screen changes; the crewmate's next step simply starts sooner.
